trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is nothing extra to do — the platinum unlocks the moment the last one pops. Finish the story, the 100% Completion checklist and the cleanup, and this follows on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1 — it unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends and Chapter 2 begins. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3. It unlocks automatically when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission of the story. It unlocks automatically with the credits, and free-roam continues afterwards, so nothing is locked behind it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — about 60% true completion — but the robbery lines allow no skips: all 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 vaults. See the Roadmap tab for all 35 lines.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories — the under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which you have done. Most come naturally through the story and the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges, at two range locations: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Each challenge has three difficulty tiers — gold all of them. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Some locations charge an entry fee. Find them on the map under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count — track them under Progress > Activities > Racing. There are 40 unique race locations, and most let you hire a car; check its Rating before entering with your own car, and upgrade it at a Mod Shop if needed.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you about a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat his challenge — the target is a parrotfish over 2 kg. You need a boat and a fishing rod; boats can be taken nearby.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one of them — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and is marked automatically in Chapter 3: a call from Andy, then her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton (Maritime Disputes). His questline is marked in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector to dig chests from the ocean floor and bring them back. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy (Hometown Heroes). His questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (Skunk Ape: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, mentoring, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and deliveries). Track the count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His Wish List questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars: scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, steal them and deliver them to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering a car in good condition pays more, and he marks new locations as you complete his list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.confidence_note: Partly unconfirmed: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy. PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it — do it anyway, it costs a minute and can never be repeated.
trophies.guide: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice, and you cannot finish the last one until you can play as both characters together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends — see the steps.
steps: During Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning.
She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose “Accept” when prompted.
She shows you how to meditate. This raises the meditation counter by 1 — do it before Chapter 1 ends.
After Chapter 2: Coffee Break, meditate at the remaining 18 spots with each character.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.confidence_note: Partly unconfirmed: PowerPyx reports it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks the trophy. Complete all 15 Target Decks — they are required for 100% anyway, so the trophy should come with them.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts you about the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His quests ask you to hunt animals he requests and bring them to him. In the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities > Target Deck.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets (480 cards) in the world; any 3 complete sets count. Track them under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this comes along the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1). The scannable types are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — more than 100 exist, so any 100 count. Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this unlocks on the way. View them under Progress > Challenges; most complete naturally while working on the other trophies. Save the hardest ones for last and pick the easiest remaining.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Available after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Build 4 stars, then escape — a fast sports motorcycle through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off helicopters. The trophy pops after leaving the red heat zone, not the flashing search area. It also unlocks naturally while robbing the large bank vaults for 100%.
steps: After Chapter 2: Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape on a fast motorcycle — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well — until you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner first, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while the wanted level stays up — keep the flashing red/blue level, not the solid red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing. The unlock is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) work well — loot a few items and the back-room safe in each.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1) counts — stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; you do not need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this comes naturally. Track them under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, and level Focus up (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots). Line up 5 enemies close together — gang operations work — and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — one connected to a boarding bridge; the planes on the open airfield do not work. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport — the unlock is slightly delayed.
steps: Drive through a fence onto the VCIA airfield and head for the plane at terminals E3/E4.
Use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs and enter the cockpit.
Reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies (green map icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. In the back room, find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot; the trophy pops shortly after leaving.
steps: Finish Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun.
Loot the safe with the code from the back-room note, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave the store undetected — the trophy pops shortly after.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his Payday Loan quests) to find more vaults. Robbing a vault gives an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs; 100% wants all 8.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to learn vault robberies.
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips to mark more vaults.
Tail a security van to a bank, enter while the vault is open and rob it with your partner.
Escape the 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as an armored truck robbery. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests) and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but 100% wants all 39. They appear as yellow map icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — only that car counts, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to break in. Drive forward straight through the showroom window; the unlock pops a moment later, once you are out on the street.
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and break into the blue Banshee.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow it with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. The location is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and the robbery icon respawns later if you miss an item.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police — the trophy unlocks after the escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always work out together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) so the other character trains at the same time and you make double progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) — a demon face appears whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count, across five profile tiers (Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable). It happens passively while working on the other trophies; the trophy list shows your count out of 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.confidence_note: Method unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner (Little Cuba, Vice City). Treat any method you see elsewhere as unverified until a guide confirms it.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No verified unlock exists yet. The best lead is the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, Vice City — possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner — but this is unconfirmed speculation, not a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky: the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random — if the car is not there, drive away and come back.
steps: Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back.
Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light and approach the UFO.
Talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best.
steps: Get on any bike in a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — the most expensive items. Shop types include 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (there are also 4 story garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage — at first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
steps: Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) so you have parking spots.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register, in his garage. Repeat for 10 vehicles.
